requirements.requirement: The system must render an overall score header when a valid explainability payload with an overall score is present.
The system must display the overall score as a numeric value formatted consistently (e.g., integer or one decimal place).
The system must render a list of measures when the payload contains a non-empty measures array.
The system must display each measure with its name, score, and contribution value.
The system must visualize contribution values using a proportional representation (e.g., bar width or percentage text).
The system must ensure contribution visualizations are normalized so that all contributions sum to 100% when valid weights are provided.
The system must render explainability content within the existing MessageBubble structured content pipeline without breaking markdown rendering.
The system must preserve message ordering and not alter non-explainability message content when rendering explainability UI.
The system must handle empty measures arrays by rendering the overall score header without measure rows.
The system must handle missing contribution values by rendering measure rows without visualization while avoiding runtime errors.
The system must not render explainability UI when the payload does not conform to the schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must fail gracefully by rendering a fallback message or nothing when the explainability payload is null or undefined.
The system must ensure all numeric values (scores and contributions) are validated as numbers before rendering.
The system must prevent rendering crashes by guarding against malformed payload structures (e.g., missing keys or incorrect types).
The system must render contribution labels in a human-readable format (e.g., percentages with % symbol).
The system must ensure visual consistency of explainability elements with existing chat UI styles defined in MessageBubble.tsx.
